title: Wardrobe types
description: Item types, in two levels: a group (no parent) and the types inside it. An item refers to one type by id.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Saved wardrobes refer to it, so it is never renamed or reused once shipped.

parent.description: Id of the group this type belongs to. Leave out for a group.

region.description: Body region the photo recogniser looks for. A type without one uses its group’s. Only regions the code knows are allowed.

sizeSystems.description: Size systems offered when adding an item of this type, ids from size-systems.json. A type without one uses its group’s.

spicy.description: True when items of this kind are usually spicy: the app suggests the spicy flag when one is added, and hides the entry while the spicy switch is off.

whering.description: Names Whering uses for this entry, so a Whering import files items under it. The entry’s own id also matches.
